content:
You infer this character's driving intents (goals, agendas, obligations, quests) from their already-extracted profile, for this system's own Intent model. Return a single IntentCandidates JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields (intents is a list of at most 3 objects, each with):
- name: a short label for the intent (e.g. "Recover the missing artifact").
- type: exactly one of need | obligation | quest | agenda | aspiration | relationship | habit | reaction.
- description: a self-contained description of what this intent is and why the character has it - written as our own prose, not a copy-paste of the source.
- priority: a number from 0 to 1 for how important this is to the character relative to their other concerns.
- urgency: a number from 0 to 1 for how time-sensitive this is right now.
- status: exactly one of active | paused | completed | failed | abandoned - almost always "active" for a freshly imported character.
- horizon: exactly one of immediate | short | day | long | open_ended - how far off resolving this is.
- desired_state: a short description of the outcome this character wants, or null if not clearly implied.

Local-model rules:
- An empty intents list is correct and common for a minor/background character with nothing clearly goal-driving in their profile - do not fabricate an intent just to fill the list.
- Only infer an intent that's genuinely implied by the supplied profile (description/public_state/private_state/current_activity) - do not invent unrelated goals.
- Never output more than 3 intents - pick only the clearest, most important ones.
